_provenance.paragraph_numbering: ¶N per the numbering scheme defined in hand_lift_provenance.json (436 non-empty paragraphs, table cells included).
_provenance.instrument_note: MSCA-PF is a single-fellow, single-beneficiary action, not a consortium. Only HOST is a beneficiary legal entity. FELLOW, SUPERVISOR and CO_SUPERVISOR are natural persons. DATA_PARTNER, TRANSFER_PARTNER and VALIDATION_PARTNER are participating organisations without beneficiary status. 'Role token' means an identifier the work plan assigns work to, not a consortium seat.
_provenance.identity_spine_source: The draft names no person. FELLOW, SUPERVISOR and CO_SUPERVISOR identities come from operator input pack item 7 (identity spine, confirmed 2026-08-11), which is the same authority ticket 3 used for the selected_call.json spine note. HOST is named by the draft (cover block ¶8, §3.2 ¶425) and corroborated by item 7.
_provenance.unresolved_scope: Resolved at ticket 6. MATE, MVCRI and AgroVIR now carry their legal name and participation mode from operator input pack items 1 and 2, answered 2026-08-11. Their full identity records, and the fields that remain open on them, live in partners.json.

ticket6_fold.what: Legal name and participation mode folded onto DATA_PARTNER, TRANSFER_PARTNER and VALIDATION_PARTNER; all three move from Unresolved to Confirmed. The three natural-person tokens and HOST are unchanged.

roles.current_affiliation: Maritsa Vegetable Crops Research Institute (MVCRI), Bulgarian Agricultural Academy, Plovdiv, Bulgaria
roles.profile: Combines a foundation in agronomy, plant protection and plant physiology with developing expertise in EO, GIS and agricultural data science. Experience in physiological measurements and crop experimentation supplies the biological basis; hyperspectral and EO/GIS experience bridges toward scalable monitoring; DrR - Digital Agronomist demonstrates a trajectory toward agricultural digital tools.
roles.competence_gap_addressed: Bayesian modelling, spatio-temporal AI, sensor transfer, uncertainty, domain adaptation and decision evaluation.
roles.executes: All work packages. This is a single-researcher action, so the fellow is not repeated as a per-WP participant in workpackage_seed.json.
roles.source_ref: Operator input pack item 7 (identity, confirmed 2026-08-11); §1.4 ¶212-216 (profile and competence gap, draft)
roles.note: The draft describes the researcher's profile but never names her. The name is an operator confirmation, not a draft fact, and is cited as such. Her current MVCRI affiliation is the same institute as TRANSFER_PARTNER; the two records are distinct, and item 1's contact-person correction of 2026-08-11 deliberately removed her from MVCRI's institutional seat so the cross-country test is not answerable to the person whose model it tests.
